title: The 6 Pillars of an Agentic Harness for Production — Varun Krovvidi, Resolve AI
talk_summary: Varun Krovvidi outlines six pillars for production agent harnesses: model orchestration, context engineering, causal reasoning, governed actions, learning loops, and evals. The talk is mostly architecture-level, but it gives copyable mechanisms for routing per task, controlling context, requiring evidence chains, scoping permissions, and learning from interactions.

takeaways.what_they_do: They route each subtask type—reasoning, deterministic, image/SQL/log analysis—to the best model and continuously re-evaluate as models change.
takeaways.evidence_quote: it needs to be able to marry the best model for the best task

takeaways.what_they_do: They treat context as a precise budget: too much causes overexploration, too little causes underexploration, so they define targeted tool calls and retrieval.
takeaways.evidence_quote: what is the precise amount of context AI needs to solve that specific problem

takeaways.what_they_do: They require root-cause claims to rest on a causal chain of evidence; if the chain is missing, they report low confidence and point elsewhere instead of agreeing with the user.
takeaways.evidence_quote: the root cause is always based on a causal chain of evidence

takeaways.what_they_do: They treat every interaction as learning signal: positive/negative reinforcement, traced paths, scoring against a strong engineer, and confidence calibration, rerun on model or architecture changes.
takeaways.evidence_quote: Every interaction that uh you're doing with an AI system is an opportunity for learning

takeaways.what_they_do: They define read/write permissions and conditions for writes per scenario, using least-privilege access for agent actions.
takeaways.evidence_quote: What is the least privilege access that AI can operate with in any given scenario?

takeaways.what_they_do: They spin up investigator agents across code, infra, knowledge bases, and observability, and surface rejected theories to reduce anchoring and support multiplayer debugging.
takeaways.evidence_quote: it's also showing out some other ruled out theories
